value.rationale: The 2026 Zhang-Ren paper exhibits an expansive APP system failing specification with a globally one-marker coordinate, which is nontransitive. The construction here shows that enforcing only a sublinear *local* marker density yields mixing at any prescribed nonzero marker-growth exponent and still satisfies the source paper's stronger prescribed-position APP. Identical invariant-measure simplices, all restricted-potential pressures and full periodic point counts conceal a continuum of nonconjugate systems, distinguished by an explicit invariant word-complexity exponent. This is a natural structural contrast, not a finite census, textbook renaming, or a routine fixed-marker-count increment.
